# Greenly

> > Greenly is a climate tech platform helping companies measure, reduce, and offset their carbon footprint through CSRD compliance, ESG reporting, and decarbonization strategies.

Greenly provides Climate Suite software for carbon accounting and ESG management, serving 3,500+ companies across retail, food & beverage, manufacturing, logistics, real estate, and education sectors. The platform supports compliance with CSRD, SBTi, and Net Zero frameworks in France, Europe, UK, and US markets.

## Key Topics

- Carbon footprint measurement
- CSRD compliance
- ESG reporting and strategy
- Net Zero targets
- SBTi (Science Based Targets initiative)
- Climate Suite platform
- Decarbonization strategies
- Supplier engagement
- Carbon credits and offsetting
- Emissions reduction
- Greenwashing prevention
- Sustainable procurement
- GHG Protocol
- Climate action
- Carbon management

## Compliance & ESG Strategy Guides

- [CSRD as an Opportunity - The Guide to Uniting Transparency and Performance with Greenly](https://greenly.earth/en-gb/resources/csrd-as-an-opportunity): CSRD compliance whitepaper with 7-step roadmap and implementation guide
- [Comment financer sa stratégie ESG ?](https://greenly.earth/resources/comment-financer-sa-strategie-esg): Guide to ESG financing & subsidies in France, Europe, US, and UK
- [Greenlys ESG-Bericht 2024](https://greenly.earth/de-de/resources/greenly-esg-report-2024): Greenly's 2024 ESG report: 3,500+ companies' decarbonization journey
- [Principles for Responsible Corporate Communication](https://greenly.earth/en-us/resources/responsible-communication): Whitepaper on avoiding greenwashing in environmental corporate claims

## Industry-Specific Decarbonization

- [A Holistic Overview of the Food & Beverage Industry's Carbon Footprint](https://greenly.earth/en-us/resources/food-and-beverage-carbon-footprint): Food & beverage decarbonization whitepaper aligned with Paris Agreement
- [Empowering Sustainability in the Retail Industry](https://greenly.earth/en-us/resources/retail-industry-one-pager): Retail sustainability one-pager: CSRD/SBTi compliance via Climate Suite
- [Heavy Duty, Low Carbon: Sustainability for Machinery Manufacturers](https://greenly.earth/en-us/resources/heavy-machinery-manufacturing-one-pager): Heavy machinery manufacturing sustainability one-pager with lifecycle analysis
- [Approvisionnement durable : Un plan pour remporter des contrats](https://greenly.earth/resources/sustainable-procurement-a-roadmap-to-winning-corporate-contracts): Sustainable procurement whitepaper for winning corporate contracts

## Case Studies

- [F2A mesure ses émissions avec Greenly !](https://greenly.earth/case-study/f2a-extended): F2A 2022 GHG emissions report with Greenly carbon measurement
- [Foodvisor Bilan Carbone](https://greenly.earth/case-study/foodvisor): Foodvisor nutrition app CO2 emissions measurement case study
- [Hampshire Cultural Trust Carbon Footprint](https://greenly.earth/en-us/case-study/hampshire-cultural-trust): Hampshire Cultural Trust museum carbon footprint case study
- [Education Sector Case Studies](https://greenly.earth/case-study/education): Education sector case studies: emlyon, CentraleSupélec, Babilou
- [Real Estate Case Studies](https://greenly.earth/case-study/immobilier): Real estate sector case studies: Matera and Masteos climate solutions
- [Logistics & Mobility Case Studies](https://greenly.earth/en-gb/case-study/logistic-mobility): Logistics & mobility case studies: 48Forty Solutions, Digi Haul
